species: Bos taurus (5GUP respirasome, 6ZPO ATP synthase) and Equus caballus (1HRC cytochrome c as stand-in) — a composite teaching scene, not one measured assembly

structures.interpretation: Horse heart cytochrome c (stand-in for the mobile carrier)

evidence_classes.experimental: Deposited coordinates of the respirasome, ATP synthase and cytochrome c only.
evidence_classes.derived: Orientation (flattest direction of the transmembrane subunits = membrane normal) and the membrane position (centre of the named part) from stated rules.
evidence_classes.modelled: The compartment model: respiratory control, ATP synthesis, proton leak, pH and potential are teaching-level relations with round constants.
evidence_classes.illustrative: Free proton, ATP and NADH counts, their positions and speeds, and the display time scale.

equations.name: ATP synthase
equations.formula: Jatp = (1-oligo)*x/(1+x)*ADP/(ADP+0.15), x = max(0,(pmf-140)/30); 8 H+ per 3 ATP (c8 ring) + 1 for ADP/Pi import = 11/3

clocks: Model seconds (teaching time); the model steps on a 0.02 s grid and warms up to a resting state; the animation pace follows the oxygen consumption rate.
limitations: Constants and relations are teaching values chosen to show respiratory control, oligomycin and uncoupler responses; they are not fitted to measurements.
The work does not draw electron paths through the real cofactors, the Q cycle, or the 4+4+2 proton accounting on the structure (still the classic code).
The scene combines three entries from two species; relative placement is not measured.
Compartment volumes are not modelled; concentrations are in a single teaching unit.
literature: Structure of mammalian respiratory supercomplex I1III2IV1. Cell 2016, doi:10.1016/j.cell.2016.11.012
Structure of the dimeric ATP synthase from bovine mitochondria. PNAS 2020, doi:10.1073/pnas.2013998117
Mitchell P. Chemiosmotic coupling in oxidative and photosynthetic phosphorylation. Biol Rev 1966

validation.note: The data model equals the classic compartment model bit for bit over scripted switch schedules; it is a teaching model, not a fit to measurements, and has not been reviewed by a domain expert.
